value.rationale: A natural complete classification of a reversible wave over the canonical Boolean hypercube, valid for all dimensions and all finite characteristic-three fields. The exact \(4,6,12\) order onset, six allowed primitive periods, and maximal-period concentration of order \(1-q^{-\Theta(2^d)}\) are motivated dynamical invariants not supplied by classical adjacency spectral tables. No arbitrary finite slice or speculative application is needed.
